newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bank denies link with sugar miller bad loan.
newsitem.headline: Manila bank denies link with sugar miller bad loan.

text.p: Manila's Far East Bank and Trust Co on Thursday said it had no loan exposure to sugar miller Victorias Milling Company after a newspaper reported that the firm was having difficulties meeting its debt obligations.

"In response to numerous queries from the media and other parties, Far East Bank and Trust Company has no loan/credit exposure to Victorias Milling Company nor equity investment in the company," the bank said in a statement.

The Asian Wall Street Journal in a report on Thursday said: "Market talk is that Victorias is struggling under several billion pesos of debt and that several listed banks have large exposures to the sugar miller."
Officials at Victorias could not immediately be reached for comment on the newspaper report.
Victorias' stock fell sharply on Thursday, ending at 4.50 pesos, down 80 centavos or 15 percent.
The Wall Street Journal quoted Gina Manzano, analyst at Philippine Asia Equity, as saying Victorias was being hurt by its strategy of financing most of an expansion plan through debt.
The newspaper said principal loans of Victorias and its subsidiaries amounted to about six billion pesos taken from six different banks.
It said Victorias would request a six-month moratorium on principal repayments.
